faqs.question: What does the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – BAL/Other Respiratory Samples test measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects the presence of Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB Complex) or non-tuberculosis bacteria in respiratory samples.

faqs.question: Why is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – BAL/Other Respiratory Samples test done?
faqs.answer: • This test is mainly done to diagnose infection by Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB Complex) or non-tuberculosis bacteria in the respiratory system. • Monitoring the effectiveness of treatment for tuberculosis (TB) • Confirming the presence of TB or other bacterial infections • Assessing the response to anti-TB medications

faqs.question: When is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – BAL/Other Respiratory Samples test recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: Your doctor might recommend this test if you have • Symptoms suggestive of tuberculosis such as chronic cough, weight loss, night sweats, and fatigue • Abnormal chest X-ray findings • Exposure to individuals with active TB • A positive tuberculin skin test (TST) or interferon-gamma release assay (IGRA) • Suspected non-tuberculosis bacterial infection in the respiratory system

faqs.question: What if the results of the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – BAL/Other Respiratory Samples test are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate the growth of Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB Complex) or non-tuberculosis bacteria and an active TB infection or other bacterial respiratory infections.

faqs.question: What to expect during the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – BAL/Other Respiratory Samples test?
faqs.answer: A healthcare professional will collect a respiratory sample (such as BAL or sputum) in a sterile container, which will be sent to the lab for testing.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – BAL/Other Respiratory Samples test?
faqs.answer: There are no specific preparations required before this test. However, it is important to provide accurate clinical history and information about any ongoing medications to your healthcare provider. Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – BAL/Other Respiratory Samples test?
faqs.answer: • Chest X-ray: This imaging test helps assess the condition of the lungs and detect abnormalities. • Acid-Fast Stain: This test helps identify acid-fast bacteria, including Mycobacterium tuberculosis. • GeneXpert MTB/RIF: This molecular diagnostic test detects the presence of Mycobacterium tuberculosis and evaluates resistance to rifampicin, an important anti-TB medication.

faqs.question: What is the AFB Rapid Culture by MGIT – BAL/Other Respiratory Samples test also known as?
faqs.answer: AFB culture, AFB smear and culture, or mycobacterial culture

faqs.question: What is tuberculosis (TB)?
faqs.answer: Tuberculosis (TB) is a contagious bacterial infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. It primarily affects the lungs but can also affect other parts of the body. TB can cause symptoms such as persistent cough, weight loss, night sweats, and fatigue. It is important to diagnose and treat TB promptly to prevent its spread and potential complications.
